preserved_timbres.tone: Sine mixed with a phase-shifted triangle; squared-sine attack/release; exponential decay and exponential pitch glide.
preserved_timbres.latest_sparkle: Note onsets 0, 0.055, 0.12 seconds; lengths 0.09, 0.11, 0.22 seconds; relative levels 1, 0.85, 0.70; triangle blend 0.18.
preserved_timbres.earlier_mint: Note onsets 0, 0.065, 0.135 seconds; lengths 0.10, 0.11, 0.21 seconds; relative levels 1, 0.86, 0.68; triangle blend 0.19.
preserved_timbres.soft_tick: One-pole filtered noise mixed 80/20 with a 740 Hz or 210 Hz sine; short exponential envelope. The 0.17 filter coefficient is adjusted to preserve its 48 kHz response at other export rates.

original_adaptations: Ten short game cue arrangements, not a copy of either 15-second soundtrack.
Action-ready, anticipation and impact cues combine the established instrumental formulas; labels describe reusable interaction roles.
Deterministic xorshift32 noise replaces Python's random generator; its per-cue seed derives from 0x52465354.
Mono cues are independently normalized to a maximum sample amplitude of 0.7; no trailer mastering gain or LUFS claim is reused.
Runtime master gain is at most 0.3 with at most four active cues, bounding the theoretical summed amplitude below 1.
No ambient music, remote assets, encoded audio or external synthesis dependencies are loaded by the runtime.
